foot: x, y = bottom-centre pixel of the 16x16 cell; draw the sticker at left = x - 8, top = y - 15
fill_rule: Dish slots fill as Quilo stickers (everyday dishes) are earned, one dish per slot, in 'order', and never empty. Only slots whose 'from_stage' is reached are used. When every slot is full, each new dish replaces the oldest one shown, so the room always shows the latest dishes. Slots with hide_at_night are not drawn at night (chairs are up). Draw stickers after the base, sorted by y then x; draw the rain overlay over everything. Outside, the pavement tables are empty in the rain look as drawn, so hide their slots when raining too.
